text: In the wavelength-multiplexed broadcast-and-weight approach, the drop fraction of a detuned add-drop ___ sets each synaptic weight magnitude, and a balanced photodetector extends the weight to signed values in [-1, 1].
explanation: A detuned add-drop microring resonator acts as an analog multiplier: its drop transmission sets |w|, and balanced detection of the drop versus through ports makes the weight signed. All wavelengths then sum automatically in the photocurrent.
